'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Shaun Janssen DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Shaun Janssen]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Last Place Deck DS
* '''Username:''' Jeritarius98
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
